Container.Name: logseq-selfhost-sync
Container.Overview: Logseq Sync Server – self-hosted Logseq database synchronization service using the Node Adapter. Provides a private, self-hosted alternative to Logseq's official sync service for managing note synchronization across devices.
Container.Requires: Create a backup of your local graph first before syncing! Optionally use with a) Tailscale by changing "DB_SYNC_BASE_URL=http://<your.tailscale.ip>:8787", b) cloudflared + authentication, c) reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik) for HTTPS. Cognito credentials are required for JWT validation unless customized.

Config.Name: --- Storage ---
Config.Description: Data storage for synchronization database and assets.

Config.Name: Volume: Sync Data
Config.Description: Logseq sync database and asset storage. Persists graph data and user information. Using an own share on a trusted drive is recommended!

Config.Name: SYNC_PORT
Config.Description: Container port for sync service (should match Port above)

Config.Name: DB_SYNC_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Public URL for the sync service. For Tailscale: http://<your.tailscale.ip>:8787. For reverse proxy: use HTTPS URL. See Requires section for options.

Config.Name: DB_SYNC_DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Path to data directory inside container

Config.Name: DB_SYNC_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error

Config.Name: --- Cognito Authentication ---
Config.Description: Logseq Cognito OAuth2 credentials for JWT validation. These are standard Logseq public values.

Config.Name: COGNITO_ISSUER
Config.Description: Cognito issuer URL for JWT validation

Config.Name: COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Cognito client ID for JWT validation

Config.Name: COGNITO_JWKS_URL
Config.Description: Cognito JWKS URL for JWT key validation

Config.Name: --- Advanced ---
Config.Description: Advanced security and administration settings. Only modify if you know what you are doing.

Config.Name: DB_SYNC_ADMIN_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional: Long random secret for hardening maintenance/admin endpoints. Leave empty to disable.
